messages:
sarah: :rotating_light: incident-bot triggered: meter-emitter shard 7 in eu-west showing sustained heartbeat jitter + delayed emits. overage flags spiking for a subset of customers. seeing gap ~00:45 - starting triage.
incident-bot: [ALERT] meter-emitter-eu shard-7 heartbeat='jittery' emit-latency=1200ms anomalies=12 - runbook: /runbooks/metering/heartbeat.md
alex: acknowledging, taking oncall. pulling latest emitter logs now. first suspicion: consumer lag on the multiregion-kafka reader.
maria: pinging infra to confirm consumer group rebalance status. @lee please watch for possible autoscale flaps.
lee: infra confirms a brief consumer rebalance at 03:12UTC, but group stabilized. no autoscale events.
jon: I see late delivery timestamps in the emitter logs: consumer processed messages with event_time older than ingestion_time by ~30-90s. token counts look duplicated in the windowing aggregator.
sarah: customers with overage flags = 18 so far, mostly mid-tier. need a quick mitigation to stop new false flags and kick off reconciliation.
alex: mitigation plan: 1) disable real-time overage alerting for impacted route (metering.api.v1.emit) 2) route emits from shard-7 to backup consumer group (consumer-group: meter-ingest-failover) 3) start fast reconciliation job for last 2 hours.
maria: please post the exact commands for step 2 so I can run them.
alex: command: 
```
# move partition assignments for shard-7 to failover group
kafka-reassign --topic meter-emitter-shard-7 --to-consumer-group meter-ingest-failover --timeout 60s
```
runbook note: this will cause ~5-10s lag while rebalance completes.
lee: infra approves the failover, will be ready to execute on go.
jon: before failover: snapshot current counters to s3 and mark the reconciliation anchor. snippet: `curl -X POST https://internal-api/recon/snapshot?shard=7`
sarah: go for failover now?
alex: going now.
incident-bot: executing automated step: paused billing-alerter for route=metering.api.v1.emit (user-facing alerts suppressed).
maria: applying kafka-reassign now...
lee: observer: consumer-group switched, partition assignment complete. seeing consumer lag drop to ~200ms.
john: (typo: jon) sorry, double-checking counters - duplication windows reduced. overage flags stopped increasing. :thumbsup:
sarah: good. start the fast reconciliation job and produce an estimated ETA.
jon: starting recon job - backfill window 02:30-04:00 UTC, using dedupe heuristic: (event_id, user_id, approximate_ts). ETA ~18m given current throughput.
alex: notifying billing team and support: we should hold off on automated credits until after manual review. @billing-bot please create ticket.
billing-bot: created BILL-2026 ticket linked to incident-1767766550, assignee=billing-ops, priority=high.
maria: recon job running, so far processing 40% of window, looks like counters will converge to expected levels. no customer self-reports yet.
sarah: customer comms draft: "We've detected a metering telemetry delay causing temporary duplicate counts for a subset of customers between 02:30–03:15 UTC. We've mitigated the source and are running a reconciliation. No charges will be finalized while we investigate. We'll follow up with account-level findings." Approve?
alex: approve, send to affected accounts list once recon completes and billing-ops gives green.
lee: notes for postmortem: shard-7 consumer group experienced a transient pause due to an uncoordinated consumer rebalance triggered by a node reclaim. look into consumer restart backoff and add jitter.
jon: digging logs: emitter shows occasional GC spikes on node eu-worker-07 that align with the hiccup. aligning with infra to snapshot heap and bump OOM thresholds.
billing-bot: billing stop-gap: temporarily paused automated overage escalations for impacted accounts; manual review flagged in BILL-2026.
sarah: good. next steps: 1) finish recon (ETA ~10m), 2) billing-runhold until manual verify, 3) create postmortem draft and assign action items.
alex: assigning postmortem owner: maria.
maria: got it. will start the doc and include log snippets, timeline, and remediation.
sarah: thanks all. will update stakeholders in 15. :eyes:
